## Resume builder tools

[Resume builder](https://zubairaziz.dev/tools/resume-builder/): build a resume in the browser. The page exposes WebMCP tools, so an AI agent with browser access can read and fill the form:

- `get_resume` — Read the current resume as JSON.
- `set_resume` — Replace the resume with a complete new object.
- `clear_resume` — Reset the resume to empty.
